answer: Behavioral Fingerprint Divergence. Agents earn a slowly built ivory reputation ledger from verified interaction traces. Post-hoc, a detector compares each new identity's behavioral fingerprint against known sybil clusters; matches trigger retroactive penalties on the parent. Attackers must sustain distinct, costly interaction histories per clone. Each identity pays weeks of genuine walnut-grade activity before it can act, and copied behavioral patterns harbor detectable correlations that collapse the whole cluster.
